article.headline: Olise goal cancelled by Bastoni strike as France draws with Italy
article.summary: Michael Olise scored for France before Alessandro Bastoni equalized to earn Italy a 1-1 draw in the Nations League at Stade de France.
article.body:
Michael Olise opened the scoring at the Stade de France with a shot from outside the box that crashed in via the underside of the bar, following a free-kick rolled to him by Rayan Cherki. Italy replied as Alessandro Bastoni stole the ball off Lucas da Cunha and beat the advanced goalkeeper Mike Maignan from the edge of the penalty area to secure a point for the visitors.

This match represented Zinedine Zidane's first home game as France manager after securing two previous victories on the road during the current international break. The result marks a continuation of Italy's campaign since Roberto Mancini returned as head coach, with the team now holding a record of one win, one draw, and one loss in the competition.

Performance metrics highlight the impact of the scorers, as Bayern Munich's Olise has now been involved in 14 goals in 15 games for France throughout this year. France faced difficulty maintaining their advantage late in the fixture when Dayot Upamecano was shown a second yellow card, resulting in his expulsion and leaving the team with ten men to finish the game. Elsewhere in Group A1 action, Belgium secured a 3-0 victory against Turkey with goals from Kevin de Bruyne and Romelu Lukaku.

article.headline: India Clinches Gold Medal Showdown Against Pakistan in Asian Games Cricket
article.summary: India secured a spot in the 2026 Asian Games men's cricket gold medal match after crushing Sri Lanka by 124 runs.
article.body: Sri Lanka folded for a paltry 45 runs against India's bowling attack in the second semi-final at Korogi Sports Park. The total was a sharp contrast to India's score of 169/7, which was anchored by Ishan Kishan's unbeaten 80 runs off 46 balls. After winning the toss and choosing to field on a spin-friendly pitch, Sri Lanka allowed India to recover from an early 24/2 struggle to set a daunting target. Teenage prodigy Vaibhav Sooryavanshi provided early momentum with 38 runs off 21 balls, but it was Kishan’s masterclass of five sixes and four boundaries that proved to be the knockout blow. For cricket followers, this victory sets up a highly anticipated gold medal clash between regional rivals India and Pakistan. The final serves as the culmination of the 2026 Asian Games men's cricket competition, drawing intense interest given the history between the two teams. According to Cricbuzz, India's bowling attack was led by Jasprit Bumrah, who delivered two early strikes before Sri Lanka could even register a run. Axar Patel then dismantled the middle order, taking the wickets of captain Sahan Arachchige and Ashen Bandara in the span of four balls. This disciplined performance ensured a swift conclusion to the match, with Sri Lanka struggling to cope with the spin-friendly conditions that defined the day's play in Nisshin. The gold medal match is scheduled as the next step for both teams, bringing the continental tournament to its definitive conclusion with the most awaited encounter in the sport.

news.og_title: Toxic chemicals were found in many popular cat food brands. Here’s what to know
news.og_desc: A new investigation found toxic chemicals in many popular cat food brands. Researchers tested 100 top-selling cat foods, including wet, dry and freeze-dried varieties, for more than 120 contaminants. Cadmium, a toxic metal linked to kidney and bone damage, was detected in 96% of the products tested. CBS News New York reports.

article.headline: Cadmium detected in 96 percent of top selling cat food brands tested
article.summary: A recent investigation of 100 popular cat food products discovered toxic contaminants, including cadmium, in nearly every sample analyzed.
article.body:
Cadmium, a toxic metal associated with significant kidney and bone damage in animals, has been identified in 96% of the cat food products evaluated in a new study. Researchers conducted comprehensive testing on 100 top-selling cat food varieties to determine the safety and composition of commonly purchased pet sustenance.

This investigation encompasses a wide range of options, specifically testing wet, dry, and freeze-dried products to provide a complete picture of the market. For pet owners, these findings highlight the urgent need for transparency regarding the manufacturing processes and ingredient sourcing used by major pet food brands. Understanding what constitutes the daily diet of domestic cats is essential, as prolonged exposure to heavy metals and other toxins can have severe long-term health implications for pets.

The research methodology involved screening for more than 120 different contaminants across the selected products. According to reports from CBS News New York, the presence of lead and various other toxins was also confirmed during this assessment of consumer-available pet food. This wide-scale screening underscores the prevalence of potential health hazards hiding in mainstream cat food offerings across the industry.

While the study identifies the widespread presence of these substances, it serves as a critical call to action for further regulatory oversight and safety standards. Consumers are encouraged to remain vigilant and informed about the products they select for their pets as further information regarding specific brand testing and safety thresholds becomes available following this widespread investigation.

article.headline: Magnitude 5.3 quake jolts Taranaki awake at 2:57am, rattles North Island
article.summary: A magnitude 5.3 earthquake struck 25 kilometres east of New Plymouth at 2:57am at a depth of 11km, with over 7,300 people reporting feeling strong shaking that sent household items crashing to the floor.
article.body:
The quake hit hard enough to jolt people from sleep with a loud rumble followed by violent shaking. One resident described the experience as "like a bomb the floor in my shed jumped upwards then the shaking started," while another said it was the "worst I ever felt in my 78 years." Multiple people reported household items falling or breaking during the tremor, with social media users describing the shaking as "intense" and "scariest" they had experienced.

The early-morning jolt affected a wide area across the North Island, felt as far north as Waihi and the North Shore. GeoNet classified the shaking as strong and recorded reports from over 7,300 people, with about 3,000 reporting moderate shaking. The earthquake-monitoring service reminded residents that dropping, covering, and holding during a quake is the correct action to take, and that those in bed should cover their heads.

Earth Sciences seismic duty officer Elisabetta D'Anastasio told media there is no clear link between the earthquake and volcanic activity at Mount Taranaki, despite the region being an active area where the volcano coexists with known active faults. Earthquakes in the area can be either tectonic, related to known faults, or volcano-tectonic in origin.

article.headline: Sri Lanka clinches Asian Games bronze with 63-run rout of Bangladesh
article.summary: Sri Lanka secured the Asian Games cricket bronze medal in Nisshin today by bowling Bangladesh out for 102 runs.
article.body: Bangladesh returned home empty-handed from the Asian Games for the first time after a disastrous batting display in the third-place playoff. Chasing a target of 166, the Tigers collapsed to 18 for 4 in just 3.5 overs, with three top-order batters failing to score a single run, ultimately falling 63 runs short. This result marks a sharp exit for the Litton Das-led squad, which had previously captured gold in 2010. For Sri Lanka, the victory offered a swift redemption after the team was bowled out for a record-low 45 runs against India just two days prior. The decisive performance at Korogi Sports Park saw Tharindu Ratnayake anchor the Sri Lankan innings with a blistering 65 off 32 balls. Bangladesh struggled to gain momentum throughout the chase, with only Nasum Ahmed providing a late resistance of 26 runs before the team was dismissed in 17.3 overs. The Sri Lankan bowling attack was shared effectively, as Nuwan Thushara, Tharindu Ratnayake, Vijayakanth Viyaskanth, and Wanuja Sahan claimed two wickets each to stifle any chance of a comeback. This bronze medal playoff served as the final chapter for both teams in the tournament, occurring on the same day as the gold medal match between India and Pakistan.

article.headline: 6,337 Civil Engineers Clear Licensure Exam as Top Passer Hits 93.95%
article.summary: The Professional Regulation Commission reported a 37.14% passing rate for the September 2026 Civil Engineers Licensure Examinations.
article.body:
Jude Bernard Villarba Miñoza from the Cebu Institute of Technology – University led the latest board exam rankings, securing the top spot with a 93.95 percent rating. The exam, conducted across 19 testing centers, saw 17,062 candidates face the test, with 6,337 ultimately succeeding to join the professional ranks. Results were released just five working days after the final day of testing on September 27.

This high-stakes licensure exam serves as the gateway for graduates to legally practice as civil engineers. For the institutions involved, the results also serve as a benchmark of excellence, with several universities achieving impressive performance metrics. Notably, the University of the Philippines-Los Baños achieved a perfect 100 percent passing rate, with all 75 of its examinees successfully passing the board requirements.

According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), the examinations were held on September 26 and 27, 2026. While thousands celebrated their success, the PRC noted that the results for eight examinees have been withheld pending a final determination of their liabilities under current licensure regulations. Among the top-performing schools with at least 50 examinees, De La Salle University-Manila, the University of Pangasinan, and Pangasinan State University-Urdaneta also recorded passing rates exceeding 80 percent.

The successful examinees now await the official oath-taking ceremonies to formally enter the profession. Those interested can review the complete list of successful candidates through official channels provided by the Professional Regulation Commission.

article.headline: Roughriders Hunt Playoff Berth Against Stampeders in Crucial West Division Clash
article.summary: The Saskatchewan Roughriders aim to clinch a postseason spot Friday at 9:30 p.m. ET by defeating the Calgary Stampeders.
article.body:
The Saskatchewan Roughriders look to snap a two-game losing streak and secure a playoff berth when they host the Calgary Stampeders on Friday night. The Riders currently hold an 8-6 record, tied with the BC Lions in the tight West Division standings, and a victory would effectively punch their ticket to the postseason while simultaneously winning the season series between these two rivals.

This matchup carries heavy stakes as both teams navigate the final stretch of the regular season. For Saskatchewan, the focus remains on fixing recent red-zone inefficiencies that saw them come up empty on four possessions in a 31-24 loss to BC last week. Despite the recent dip in efficiency, quarterback Trevor Harris insists the team is focused on execution rather than panic. Head coach Corey Mace emphasized that while the team discusses playoff implications, their primary goal is simply playing winning football at home.

Calgary enters the game with momentum, riding back-to-back wins over the Ottawa REDBLACKS. Receiver Jalen Philpot has been a key driver of that success, recently surpassing 1,000 yards for the first time in his career. Defensively, Calgary will look to limit Saskatchewan’s ground game, specifically running back AJ Ouellette, who returned from injury last week to record 77 yards on 19 carries. The Stampeders' defense will also be tasked with protecting late-game leads, having surrendered an average of 19 points in the fourth quarter over their last four outings.

The game is scheduled for a 9:30 p.m. ET kickoff in Regina. Fans in Canada can follow the action on TSN, while international and U.S. viewers can tune in via CFL+.

article.headline: Government Selects Horoirangi Peak Site for Critical New South Island Radar
article.summary: A new radar station will be installed near Nelson by mid-2027 to eliminate a significant weather forecasting blind spot in the South Island.
article.body:
The site for the new weather radar has been confirmed near Horoirangi Peak, situated 630 meters above sea level and approximately 15 kilometers northeast of Nelson City. This installation addresses a long-standing coverage gap that forced the Nelson Tasman region to rely on distant equipment in Wellington that could not effectively monitor the northwest Tasman area.

This project carries a total funding commitment of up to $5 million, a measure fast-tracked by the government following severe storms and flooding that occurred last July. The area has faced persistent challenges, with South Island Minister James Meager noting that the region has declared five states of emergency since 2011. Improved forecasting capability is intended to provide emergency managers, councils, and local first responders with the necessary data to prepare for future extreme weather events.

MetService will manage the installation and ongoing operation of the facility, which will feature modern Doppler dual-polarisation technology. This system is designed to provide more accurate rainfall estimates and enhance overall weather monitoring capabilities. The selection of the Horoirangi Peak location followed a rigorous evaluation of approximately 10 potential sites across the eastern hills near Nelson, the central hills around Moutere, and areas reaching toward Motueka and Kahurangi National Park. The chosen site was prioritized for its optimal altitude and the support of local landowners willing to host the infrastructure.

Operations at the new site are expected to be fully functional by mid-2027. Once active, the radar will require an annual operating budget of approximately $260,000 to maintain its service to the community.

article.headline: Edinburgh Stuns Stormers as Lineout Errors Derailed 17-13 Away Defeat
article.summary: The Stormers lost 17-13 to Edinburgh at Hive Stadium on Friday after failing to secure 11 lineouts during the second round of the URC.
article.body: The Stormers were undone by their own set-piece, surrendering possession on 11 separate occasions at the lineout in a match decided by fine margins in the wind. Trailing 3-0 at half-time, the visitors fought back to briefly claim the lead, only to see the hosts secure the victory by stealing a final lineout attempt at the death. Coach John Dobson expressed deep frustration with the performance, noting that the team’s game plan relied heavily on the maul, which became impossible to execute under the prevailing weather conditions. The loss was compounded by the early exit of hooker André-Hugo Venter, who was forced off the field midway through the first half following a failed HIA. Dobson highlighted that the loss of Venter significantly impacted the team's ability to maintain set-piece stability throughout the remainder of the contest. While Yaqeen Ahmed contributed eight points with his boot and Hacjivah Dayimani scored a try, defensive discipline issues at the breakdown allowed Edinburgh to capitalize on critical scoring opportunities. This defeat leaves the Cape Town side looking to recover from their inaccuracy as they prepare for upcoming fixtures. The team is currently shifting focus toward regrouping after this disappointing result in Scotland. Moving forward, the club is engaged in a long-term internal strategy known as Project 2029, which aims to strengthen development structures and rebuild the team as a consistent international trophy contender, emphasizing a stronger connection between the players and their support base.

article.headline: Ducks and Golden Knights square off for high-stakes season-opening Pacific rematch
article.summary: The Anaheim Ducks launch their 2026-27 season against the Vegas Golden Knights Friday in Las Vegas following their second-round playoff collision.
article.body:
The Ducks make their 2026-27 season debut in Las Vegas, aiming to build on a campaign that saw them earn their first playoff berth in eight years. The matchup serves as a rematch of last season's second-round series, where the Golden Knights eliminated Anaheim in six games, ending with a 5-1 defeat for the Ducks on May 14. Vegas enters the contest with momentum, having already secured a 5-2 win against the Chicago Blackhawks in their own season opener this past Tuesday.

For Anaheim, the game marks the start of a critical year in the competitive Pacific Division. Head coach Joel Quenneville, entering his second year, views the team’s postseason experience as a foundation for growth. The roster features high-profile star Leo Carlsson, who remained with the franchise after the Ducks matched a five-year, $90 million offer sheet from the Philadelphia Flyers. Carlsson, coming off a 67-point season, joins forward Cutter Gauthier, who led the squad with 41 goals, in leading a lineup looking to prove their staying power against a division rival that finished just three points ahead of them last year.

NHL.com reports that Ducks forward A.J. Greer is expected to play after missing the preseason with an injury, while Judd Caulfield prepares to make his NHL debut. On the defensive side, Luneau will skate on the top pair following his new six-year, $43.2 million contract. Meanwhile, the Golden Knights are expected to ice the same 18-skater group that defeated Chicago earlier this week. The Ducks currently list Troy Terry as sidelined with a hip injury, along with Drew Helleson and Ian Moore.

The game is set for a 10 p.m. ET start as the Ducks seek to reverse the result of their last postseason encounter with the Golden Knights.

article.body:
Hyundai Motor Group has officially overtaken Honda Motor in the U.S. hybrid vehicle market during the first half of the year. This shift marks the first time the South Korean automaker has surpassed its Japanese rival, signaling a notable change in consumer preference within the automotive sector.

The growing consumer shift toward hybrid technology is driven by sustained high gasoline prices across the country, which have pushed Americans to reconsider their vehicle choices. As demand for these fuel-efficient models continues to rise, major Asian manufacturers are positioned at the forefront of the market, with Hyundai successfully capturing a larger portion of the growing hybrid customer base.

Nikkei Asia reports that while Hyundai is rapidly expanding its sales volume, Japanese automakers are currently facing difficulties meeting the heightened demand for hybrid inventory. This struggle to match production with market interest has allowed Hyundai to exert significant pressure on its competitors. To maintain this momentum, Hyundai Motor CEO Jose Munoz recently showcased the redesigned Tucson SUV during an event in New York on Oct. 1.

Industry analysts and consumers alike are watching to see how Japanese rivals will adjust their supply chains to combat this market shift. With the appetite for hybrid cars remaining strong among U.S. buyers, the competitive landscape between these international giants is expected to intensify throughout the remainder of the fiscal year.

article.headline: South Korea threatens further measures against Ukraine over prisoner transfer dispute
article.summary: President Lee Jae-myung demanded a public apology from Kyiv after Ukraine disclosed the secret transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war.
article.body:
South Korean President Lee Jae-myung warned of unspecified further measures on Friday unless Ukraine issues a public apology for unilaterally disclosing the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul. The dispute centers on whether a confidentiality agreement existed regarding the soldiers, who were captured fighting for Russia. While Seoul maintains that Kyiv requested the transfer be kept secret to protect the soldiers' families and to facilitate future prisoner swaps with Russia, Ukrainian officials have claimed there was no such agreement.

The standoff follows a disclosure made by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the United Nations General Assembly last week. President Lee stated that the public revelation undermined the dignity of the Republic of Korea and accused Kyiv of making him appear to be a liar. Lee also expressed regret over comments from Ukraine that he described as prayers for the outbreak of a military clash on the Korean Peninsula.

For Ukraine, the situation presents a delicate diplomatic challenge with a key international partner. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha characterized the conflict as a diplomatic misunderstanding on Thursday, stating that Kyiv is working to resolve the issue in the near future. He emphasized that South Korea remains an important country for Ukraine and expressed hope for continued momentum and concrete results in their bilateral relationship.

Domestic pressure in South Korea has intensified the situation, with opposition politicians accusing President Lee of attempting to hide the transfer to appease Pyongyang. The North Korean soldiers involved were among thousands deployed to support Russia's war effort. Their identity became public after being photographed by South Korean media upon arrival, raising concerns about potential retaliation by North Korea against their relatives.

Grace Hayden is shutting down accusations that her media career rests on her father Matthew Hayden’s sporting reputation rather than her own effort. The 24-year-old presenter rejects the narrative that she relies on her surname, emphasizing that her roles in high-profile sports coverage are built on extensive research and hard work. While she acknowledges the challenges of growing up as the daughter of a cricket legend, she confirms that she has learned to balance these external opinions with her own professional reality.

For Hayden, these criticisms are not new; she recalls facing similar skepticism since childhood, including claims that her positions on sports teams were unearned. Addressing these remarks is significant for her as she continues to expand her footprint in sports media, moving from cricket coverage in the Big Bash League and India’s IPL to sideline reporting for the NRL. Her defense highlights the internal pressure she has navigated while establishing her identity in a competitive industry.

According to Stellar, Hayden maintains that she does the hard yards necessary to succeed in broadcasting. She currently works across various disciplines, including tennis and motorsports. Reflecting on her path, she notes that she once wrestled with the constant association to her father, but now chooses to embrace her family background while remaining firm about her personal contribution. Outside of her professional life, she resides on a farm in Moree, New South Wales, with her partner, business executive Wilson Statham, and continues to rely on her inner circle to stay grounded despite public scrutiny.

article.headline: Shivon Zilis confirms sudden end to relationship with billionaire Elon Musk
article.summary: Neuralink executive Shivon Zilis announced her romantic separation from Elon Musk after the billionaire unfollowed her on X.
article.body:
It’s hard to go from in love to let go in a week with no warning, but that’s just how it is sometimes, Shivon Zilis, 40, posted on X following her split from billionaire Elon Musk. The director of operations and special projects at Neuralink shared that the relationship ended abruptly, noting she would miss the father of four of her children dearly while hoping to remain friends and co-parents.

The public disclosure follows visible shifts on the social media platform X, where Zilis noted that Musk had unfollowed her. In a series of shared messages, Musk had expressed affection for Zilis as recently as last week, stating he would have invited her to a state dinner between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping had he realized the event included significant others. Zilis described her role as a counterbalancing force, providing stability and gentleness to the billionaire.

According to The Telegraph, Zilis and Musk, 55, have four children conceived via in-vitro fertilisation over the past five years. Their relationship history includes Zilis’s service on the board of OpenAI, where she frequently acted as a go-between during legal tensions between Musk and the company. She previously testified that their personal connection originated from a one-off encounter at a corporate event in 2015.

Reports from The Times of India highlight that Musk had previously referenced Zilis’s background in public, including her Indian ancestry, while addressing questions about his personal life. Zilis concluded her announcement by wishing Musk well, stating that the world is lucky to have him. There are no further details regarding the future of their professional collaborations at Neuralink.

article.headline: Jim Carrey weds girlfriend Min Ah in private Los Angeles ceremony at 64
article.summary: Canadian actor Jim Carrey, 64, married his girlfriend Min Ah, 32, in a small private ceremony in Los Angeles, seven months after publicly thanking her as his 'sublime companion' at the César Awards in Paris.
article.body:
Jim Carrey has married again after decades of avoiding the altar. The 64-year-old Ace Ventura star tied the knot with Min Ah, 32, in a private Los Angeles ceremony, according to his spokesperson's confirmation to People on September 30. The couple kept the wedding date, venue, and guest list confidential.

Carrey's relationship with Ah remained largely private until their public debut together in February at the César Awards in Paris, where the actor accepted an honorary award. During his acceptance speech, delivered in French, Carrey publicly acknowledged Ah for the first time, calling her his "sublime companion" and declaring his love for her in front of his daughter Jane and grandson Jackson.

The couple was first photographed together in February 2022 after a charity comedy show hosted by Judd Apatow in Los Angeles. Carrey has previously been married twice: to Melissa Womer from 1987 to 1995, with whom he shares daughter Jane, and to Dumb and Dumber costar Lauren Holly from 1996 to 1997. The actor has been notably private about his personal life throughout his career, and tends to keep relationships out of the public spotlight.
